name: Capacity and abuse controls; load, soak, backpressure, rate limits and overload fail-closed behaviour
acceptance_scope: Repository app-audit software capacity/abuse gates. Production-equivalent capacity and prolonged soak acceptance remain C09.8.
evidence_commit_policy: Evidence-only commit inheriting the exact qualified implementation; evidence SHA is the Git commit containing this file. No executable/test/workflow/dependency/configuration/deployment/substantive requirement change.
classification: Compliance package/database/HTTP and app qualification only; no shared Go module, protocol, Solidity, Genesis or frozen-address changes.
implementation_summary: Role-bound database-clock shared rate admission and transaction-backed fleet concurrency slots
Fixed work/recovery reserves without dynamic IP/credential identity cardinality or local waiting queues
Bounded body/response buffering, cancellation/operation and transport deadlines; no late ALLOW or partial private response
Separate managed production admission pool so held slots do not exhaust admitted storage work
Serialized durable-job count/payload backpressure and database triggers; idempotent recovery retained
Atomic activation/outbox rollback on unacknowledged backlog exhaustion; halt and acknowledgment preserve existing authority
Add migration seven with RLS and restricted runtime grants; preserve original first-six migration checksums

capacity.proof: 16 shared work slots, two shared recovery slots, fixed bounded process queues and separate 20-connection admission versus 16-connection storage pools

abuse_controls.proof: Fixed role-bound scope/lane counters; forwarded headers/client scope cannot choose identity; no counter insert/delete privilege; body/header/response/time limits

load.proof: 32,000 requests from 32 producers, bounded capacity and exact admit/reject/backend accounting

soak.proof: 30-second TLS/real PostgreSQL admission soak with measured counts/peak concurrency and fixed two-counter cardinality; actual production extended soak deferred C09.8

backpressure.proof: 1,024 active jobs/16 MiB payload and 2,048 unacknowledged outbox cap; SQL triggers, serialized admission, full-queue replay and rollback

rate_limits.proof: 120 work and 30 recovery admissions per DB-clock fixed one-second window; two-instance contention; no budget overshoot; recovery independence

overload_fail_closed.proof: Overload/database/managed-identity/missing-state/deadline/response-cap denial; no backend on rejected admission, no late ALLOW, no partial activation/export; emergency halt remains callable

diagnosed_failures.cause: Backlog fixture reused one scope/sequence/subscriber triple, violating the existing outbox uniqueness constraint before the capacity assertion
diagnosed_failures.repair: Use distinct fixture subscribers for the 2,048 valid rows; preserve uniqueness constraint, capacity assertion and original protocol semantics

limitations: Aggregate per-scope rate protection is not per-user fairness; a fixed-window boundary may allow two adjacent bursts
Recovery reserve itself can exhaust under attack and grants no availability or authorization guarantee
Handlers must honor request cancellation; a hung process needs operator termination; wrapper never emits a late response
Connection sizing across actual fleet/tenants and production SLAs require independent measurement/approval
Admission uses conservative 250-ms dependency budget and 2-second operation deadline; unapproved deployment latency never relaxes fail-closed checks
Existing raw handlers/runtime constructors remain primitives; production capacity entry is OpenC074Production plus NewC074Server and external TLS
Audit branch divergence remains for canonical C08.5 reconciliation, not a claim of merge readiness
